attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: GE Power India Limited filed an investors’ presentation for its earnings conference call scheduled on 16 November 2026 at 03:30 P.M. IST. The presentation covers Q2 and Half Year 2026-27 results. The company reported a 38% quarter-on-quarter growth in order inflows and an 11% quarter-on-quarter growth in revenue from operations. Core services recorded approximately 43% quarter-on-quarter growth. The company booked the Shoaiba Fuel Conversion Project for Saudi Energy in the September 2026 quarter, amounting to approximately INR 76 crores. It also secured an order for major emergency Boiler refurbishment from UPRUVNL for approximately INR 26 crores. Revenue increased by approximately 11%, driven by Core and Upgrade volumes. The net cash position includes cash pool lending at INR 741 crores. Discontinued operations include the proposed demerged business of Durgapur.

attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication   regarding publication of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 and Opening of Special Window for Transfer and Dematerialization of Physical Securities.
voiceSummary: GE Power India Limited published newspaper advertisements on 15 November 2026 regarding the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 14 November 2026. The company also announced the opening of a special window for the transfer and dematerialization of physical securities sold or purchased prior to 01 April 2019. This window is open for a period of one year, from 05 February 2026 to 04 February 2027. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express, The Free Press Journal, and Navshakti.

attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation for update of contact details of Key Managerial Personnels under Regulation 30(5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations )'.

attchmntText: GE Power India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: GE Power India Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 on 13 November 2026. The Board noted the Limited Review Report issued by Deloitte Haskins & Sells. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, the company reported a net profit of 853.4 million rupees, compared to 620.4 million rupees in the same period of 2025. Revenue from operations stood at 6,199.2 million rupees, up from 5,672.5 million rupees in the prior year. Basic and diluted earnings per share from continuing operations and discontinued operations were 12.70 rupees, compared to 9.23 rupees in the previous year. The results are available on the company website.
